description: Group Trips - Invite collaborators by email, live sync with Supabase Realtime, upvote/downvote stops, and split expenses between members with 'who owes whom' summary.
steps: 1. Run migrations/005_group_trips.sql in Supabase SQL Editor. This creates: trip_members table (trip_id, user_id, role, invited_email, status), stop_votes table (trip_id, stop_id, user_id, vote), and RLS policies. Also alters trip_expenses to add paid_by_user_id and split_between UUID[] columns.

2. Create src/services/groupTripService.ts with: inviteCollaborator(tripId, email, role) that inserts into trip_members and optionally sends email via Supabase Edge Function; acceptInvitation(tripId, userId) that updates status to 'accepted'; listMembers(tripId) that fetches all members.

3. Create src/hooks/useRealtimeTrip.ts that subscribes to Supabase Realtime channel for trip updates. On UPDATE event for saved_trips table, update local itinerary state and show toast 'Trip updated by collaborator'. Return updated itinerary.
4. Integrate useRealtimeTrip in src/components/TripPlanner.tsx so changes by other members are reflected in real-time.

5. Create src/services/stopVotingService.ts with: voteStop(tripId, stopId, vote) that upserts to stop_votes; getStopVotes(tripId, stopId) that aggregates votes and returns {upvotes, downvotes, score}.
6. Create src/components/StopVoteButtons.tsx that displays 👍 upvote count, 👎 downvote count, and buttons for current user to vote. Show vote score (upvotes - downvotes) prominently.
7. Integrate StopVoteButtons into each stop card in src/components/ActivitiesItinerary.tsx. Only show for trips with multiple members.

8. Create src/services/expenseSplitService.ts with: splitExpense(tripId, expense, splitBetween[]) that updates trip_expenses with paid_by and split_between; calculateOweSummary(expenses, members) that computes net balances and generates settlement list (who owes whom how much). Use greedy settlement algorithm.
9. Create src/components/ExpenseSplitSummary.tsx that displays 'Who Owes Whom' section in ExpenseTracker. Show list of settlements like 'Alice → Bob: ₹1,200'.
10. Create src/components/InviteModal.tsx with email input, role dropdown (editor/viewer), and Send button. Show list of current members with remove option for owner.
11. Add 'Invite' button to trip header in TripPlanner. Only show for trip owner. On click, open InviteModal.
12. Add unit tests in src/services/expenseSplitService.test.ts covering settlement calculations with various expense splits and verifying balances sum to zero.
acceptance_criteria: Trip owner can invite collaborators by email with editor or viewer role
Invited users receive invitation (email if Supabase function configured, or in-app notification)
Real-time sync: when one member edits trip, others see changes with toast notification
Members can upvote/downvote stops, vote counts visible to all
Expenses can be split between specific members
ExpenseTracker shows 'Who Owes Whom' summary with correct settlement amounts
RLS policies ensure only trip members can access trip data
Unit tests pass for expense split calculations (npm run test)
verification: npm run lint - TypeScript strict mode passes
npm run test - all tests pass including expenseSplitService.test.ts
Manual: Create trip, click Invite, enter email and send
Manual: Verify trip_members row created in Supabase
Manual: Open same trip in two browser windows (same or different users), edit in one, verify other updates
Manual: Click upvote on a stop, verify count increases and vote persists after refresh
Manual: Add expense with 'Split between' selecting 2 members, verify 'Who Owes Whom' shows correct settlement
Manual: Verify settlements balance (total owed = total paid)
